ai_positioning.summary: CSG does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company focuses on SaaS platform capabilities, customer engagement solutions, and digital transformation without emphasizing AI-driven features or AI-powered capabilities.

risks.title: Cybersecurity threats and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity is explicitly mentioned as a primary risk factor with detailed risk management processes. CSG manages billions of critical customer interactions annually, making data breaches highly impactful. The company operates an ISO 27001 framework and conducts regular penetration tests and third-party audits, indicating awareness of elevated risk exposure. Stable trend year-over-year.
risks.summary: A cyberattack or data breach could compromise customer data, disrupt service delivery, damage reputation, and trigger regulatory penalties given the company's role managing critical customer interactions.

risks.title: Third-party service provider security risks
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly highlights risks from third-party service providers and systems that could adversely impact business operations. The company evaluates third-party cybersecurity threats and implements formal requirements and controls. Increased emphasis on third-party risk management indicates heightened concern relative to prior year.
risks.summary: Security incidents at external vendors or service providers could disrupt operations, compromise data integrity, and expose sensitive customer information despite contractual safeguards.

risks.title: NEC Corporation merger execution and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: The proposed merger with NEC Corporation represents an existential transaction announced on October 29, 2025. $13.7 million in transaction costs have already been incurred with estimated $10 million payable at closing, plus unquantifiable future costs. Integration risks include cultural misalignment, key talent retention, operational disruption, synergy realization uncertainty, and potential regulatory impediments. Management distraction from core business operations. This is a new material risk for fiscal 2025.
risks.summary: The pending NEC merger creates significant operational, financial, and strategic uncertainties including integration complexity, management distraction, customer retention risks, and potential deal failure or unexpected closing costs.

risks.title: Customer concentration and revenue dependency
risks.score_rationale: A large percentage of revenue is generated from a limited number of customers in the telecommunications industry. Charter Communications and Comcast each represent over 10% of revenue (Charter = $236M or 19% in 2025). Loss or significant reduction of contract with either major customer would materially impact financial performance. Charter contract extended through 2031 but with reduced price escalators. This concentration risk is material and stable.
risks.summary: Heavy reliance on a small number of major telecommunications customers, particularly Charter Communications ($236M, 19% of revenue) and Comcast (>10%), creates significant revenue vulnerability if contracts are terminated or not renewed.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance evolution in cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company continuously evaluates trends in the legal and regulatory environment, particularly regarding cybersecurity and data protection. The SaaS and software sector faces increasingly stringent regulatory requirements globally. Non-compliance could result in fines, operational restrictions, or loss of customer contracts. The 10-K indicates proactive monitoring of regulatory trends. Risk remains stable but elevated due to industry-wide regulatory intensity.
risks.summary: Evolving regulatory requirements, particularly in cybersecurity, data protection, and industry-specific compliance, could impose additional operational costs and business constraints if the company fails to maintain compliance.

risks.title: Dependence on key executive personnel
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on experienced executive leadership, with CEO Brian A. Shepherd and other key officers managing strategic execution. While the management team has industry experience, sudden loss of the CEO, CISO, or other critical leaders during the pending merger period could impair strategic direction and deal completion. Recruitment and retention of specialized talent in SaaS platforms is competitive.
risks.summary: Business performance and successful merger completion depend heavily on key executives. Unexpected departure or retirement of senior leadership could disrupt operations and strategic initiatives.

risks.title: Facility consolidation and operational disruption
risks.score_rationale: The company is consolidating operations including facility closures and reorganization activities. Restructuring charges increased 48.6% to $19.8 million in 2025. While planned and anticipated, facility closures can result in temporary operational disruptions, knowledge transfer challenges, and employee attrition. The closure of design and delivery centers could impact project delivery timelines.
risks.summary: Planned facility consolidations and operational restructuring may cause temporary service delivery disruptions, workforce transitions, and potential loss of institutional knowledge or specialized skills.
